cards.title: Agents ask you questions
cards.text: An agent asks with pinrail ask, and its questions wait in your inbox. Pick a choice or answer in your own words, add a note to any answer, and send them back together.
cards.alt: An agent session's thread: waiting questions with their choices, a note on the first answer, and the box for a comment to the agent

cards.title: Every agent session in one place
cards.text: The new Sessions page lists each agent session that asked you something or sent a review, those waiting for you first. A session opens as a thread of its questions and reviews.
cards.alt: The Sessions page: agent sessions with what waits in each, what each holds, its project and its last activity

cards.title: See what your agents are doing
cards.text: An agent reports its progress with pinrail status. Each status shows in the session's thread between its questions and reviews, and the newest under its title. Update the Pinrail skill in Settings › Agents, so that your agents start reporting.
cards.alt: An agent session's thread: statuses before and after a question that was answered with a note, and the agent saying it has finished
